Subject: PO requirements + prepayment/credit laddering question

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is starting to assemble the PO paperwork and we have a few questions before we circulate to our AP team:

1) PO identifier: our ERP requires a PO number on every invoice that maps to our project code. Can you confirm the preferred PO format you accept on invoices (e.g., prefix + numeric)? We need to validate mapping rules with our internal system.

2) Invoice cadence: do you accept split invoices (multiple invoices per PO) or do you require a single monthly invoice? TideWell prefers up to two invoices per month tied to different BU codes for budget reconciliation.

3) Net terms: TideWell’s standard is Net 60. Are you willing to support Net 60 for an annual committed contract? If there are early-pay discounts available, please detail.

4) Prepaid credits / laddering: we’re evaluating an advance-credit model (prepaying a portion of committed spend, then drawing down monthly). How do you apply prepaid credits to monthly invoices, and what are the rules around refunds or reallocation across BU codes?

Can you also send (1) your W-9, (2) a sample invoice that includes PO and BU-code fields, and (3) any standard contract language we should route to legal for prepayment/credits?

Attaching our PO template for reference.

[attachment: TideWell_PO_Template.pdf]

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement hopes to close the paperwork by Sep 15.

Best,
Lydia Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager
TideWell Health

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <l.chen@tidewellhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + prepayment/credit laddering question

Lydia — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Vanessa (AM) and Ben (Billing Ops) to confirm the implementation details; below are the options and our recommended approach so procurement has something concrete to review.

Quick answers up front:
- PO format: we can support a fixed prefix plus numeric string. Recommended: TW-##### (example: TW-2026-03421). We will map that to our invoice "PO Number" field and to the invoice reference line so it lands in your ERP.
- Split invoices: we can support up to 2 invoices per PO per month (we commonly do this for customers mapping to different BU/internal codes).
- Net terms: our standard enterprise offering is Net 45, but for a committed annual contract we can offer Net 60. For Net 60 we request either (a) an advance credit deposit equal to one month’s expected run rate, or (b) a 30-day SLA benchmark.
- Early-pay discount: we can offer 1.0% discount if payment is received within 10 days (applies to the billed amount after credits are applied).

Prepaid credit / laddering model (recommended):
- Up-front deposit: Customer prepays X USD (applied as a credit balance).
- Amortization: credits are drawn monthly against invoiced usage until exhausted.
- Reallocation: credits are attached to the master account and can be allocated to invoices across BU codes on request; reallocation requests must be submitted before month-end.
- Refunds: refundable only at contract termination and after reconciliation of outstanding invoices; refunds processed within 45 days of termination.

PO mapping requirements we need from TideWell:
1) PO number field (exact string) that will appear on invoice
2) Billing entity name and remit-to address
3) BU code(s) if you want invoices split (please provide mapping table, we can accept up to 3 BU codes per PO)

Attachments: I’ve added a sample PO→invoice mapping CSV that shows how we ingest the PO number and BU code, plus a draft clause for prepaid-credit treatment.

Next steps: can we do a 20-min call on Thu Sep 9 at 11:00 AM PT to walk procurement and AP through the mapping and the DocuSign flow? Vanessa — can you confirm availability? Ben — if you can bring the sample invoice and W-9 on the call, that will speed approvals.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
